import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core'; import { ProprietaireService } from '../../core/services/proprietaire.service'; import { AuthService } from '../../core/services/auth.service'; import { Proprietaire, Page } from '../../core/models/models'; @Component({ selector: 'app-proprietaires-list', templateUrl: './proprietaires-list.component.html' }) export class ProprietairesListComponent implements OnInit { page?: Page; loading = true; search = ''; currentPage = 0; pageSize = 10; constructor( private service: ProprietaireService, public auth: AuthService ) {} ngOnInit(): void { this.load(); } load(): void { this.loading = true; this.service.getAll(this.currentPage, this.pageSize, this.search || undefined).subscribe({ next: (p) => { this.page = p; this.loading = false; }, error: () => { this.loading = false; } }); } onSearch(): void { this.currentPage = 0; this.load(); } goToPage(p: number): void { this.currentPage = p; this.load(); } delete(id: number): void { if (!confirm('Supprimer ce propriétaire ?')) return; this.service.delete(id).subscribe({ next: () => this.load(), error: (err) => alert(err.error?.message || 'Erreur lors de la suppression') }); } }
